# Sensitivity of the cross-era claims to the coding

Counts per era over the read papers, recomputed under four codings. Era sample sizes: Era 0 n=5, Era 1 n=5, Era 2 n=11, Era 3 n=17, Era 4 n=12, Era 5 n=13, Era 6 n=15.

## G1: irregular ownership and the run-time stage

The claim: where ownership is set by an irregular or user-defined map and the system generates the
communication for it, a run-time stage (inspection or adaptation during execution) is recorded.
Population A is every read paper with irregular or user-defined ownership. Population B keeps the
papers whose communication is generated by the system (any communication value other than
programmer-explicit). Population B is the claim's own scope, and it was fixed after the Era 4 papers
were coded: Co-Array Fortran leaves communication to the programmer, so it is outside the claim.
The load-time variant counts load-time evaluation of a user map as a run-time stage.

- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), first: 18 of 26 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, seitz1985cosmic, hillis1986data, chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna, misunas1977workshop, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, misunas1977workshop, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), second: 18 of 25 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chen1988compiling, numrich1998coarray, chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chen1988compiling, chamberlain2007chapel
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), intersection: 14 of 22 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, seitz1985cosmic, hillis1986data, chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna, chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, seitz1985cosmic, hillis1986data, chamberlain2007chapel, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined
- population A (irregular or user-defined ownership), union: 24 of 29 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2005reusable, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), first: 17 of 22 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, seitz1985cosmic, hillis1986data, chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data
- population B (claim scope: system-generated communication), second: 17 of 22 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chen1988compiling, numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2006userdefined; exceptions if load time counts: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chen1988compiling

## G2: decision procedure by era (papers per procedure)

The claim tested here is that search-based decomposition is absent before 2019. Falsifiers are read papers
before 2019 whose decision procedure is profile or search, under each coding:

- first: before 2019: unat2017trends, hiranandani1992evaluation; from 2019: 5 papers
- second: before 2019: su2010irregular; from 2019: 4 papers
- intersection: before 2019: none; from 2019: 4 papers

## Robustness: surveys excluded

Surveys are coded from the systems they review, so each survey contributes several tags. The checks below
remove the survey entries (paper_type survey) and repeat the G1 population and the G2 falsifiers.

- G1 population B without surveys, first: 15 of 20 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, seitz1985cosmic, hillis1986data, chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna
- G1 population B without surveys, second: 16 of 21 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chen1988compiling, numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2006userdefined
- G1 population B without surveys, intersection: 13 of 17 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, chapman1991vienna, chapman1992vienna
- G1 population B without surveys, union: 20 of 24 have a run-time stage; exceptions: kung1982systolic, hillis1986data, numrich1998coarray, diaconescu2006userdefined
- G2 without surveys, first: before 2019 search-based: hiranandani1992evaluation
- G2 without surveys, second: before 2019 search-based: su2010irregular
- G2 without surveys, intersection: before 2019 search-based: none
- G2 without surveys, union: before 2019 search-based: hiranandani1992evaluation, su2010irregular
